name: bottom-nav
title: Bottom Nav
description: Bottom navigation in five looks — minimal dot, floating capsule, expanding pill, notched centre FAB and top indicator with a spotlight. A liquid indicator stretches between tabs (leading edge first, trailing edge catching up), icons morph from outline to filled with a spring and a lift, active labels rise in, badges pop, the solid accent action button glows softly, and every change ticks a haptic.
